meta.description: Single-drone scenario placed at a force-equilibrium point directly behind an obstacle to trigger stuck-detection.
meta.coordinate_note: axes 0,1 = horizontal plane (obstacle avoidance plane), axis 2 = up

without_noise_control_run.description: Control run with stuck noise disabled: drone remains permanently trapped at force equilibrium

with_noise_active_run.description: Active run with stuck noise enabled: random noise breaks equilibrium and drone escapes to target
